GSE193816 (52,152 Cells): Allergen-Challenged Human Asthmatic Airway

Alladina et al., Science Immunology 2023 — Bronchoscopic segmental allergen challenge in Allergic Asthma (AA_Ag) vs Allergic Non-Asthmatic Controls (ANA_Ag).
3 Single-Cell Discoveries: (1) 100% Epithelial Orthogonality: Epithelium expresses TSLP (20.3%) & IL33 (41.8%) with 0.29% CD30 overlap. (2) Autonomous CD4 CD30L Loop: CD4 T cells express 9.66% CD30L vs 0.62% OX40L (15.69x), explaining single-agent anti-OX40L ceiling in asthma! (3) 94.99% FOXP3+ Treg Sparing: Only 5.01% of airway Tregs express CD30 vs 72.54% expressing OX40!

10 Uniform NCBI_GRCh38_TPM Human Biopsy Cohorts (n = 1,642)

Includes longitudinal Month-3 Dupilumab skin biopsies (GSE157194, n=166) and PROTECT/RISK IBD mucosal cohorts (GSE109142 & GSE57945).
Longitudinal Off-Drug Relapse Proof (GSE157194): After 3 months of clinical Dupilumab therapy in human AD skin, lesional CD30L remains at 2.13 TPM (105.6% of baseline) and CD30 remains at 1.05 TPM (94.7% of baseline) — proving Dupilumab silences STAT6 without erasing CD30/CD30L T_RM!
